column1: # Vietnamese (vi) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# Clean-room translations from PdfCraft's English UI labels. Reviewed by a native
# Vietnamese-speaking contributor for the original catalog; later additions are marked below. PhotoCraft/VectorCraft Vietnamese catalogs were used only as
# translation memory when the English source and its meaning in context matched. Product and
# format names (PdfCraft, PDF, PDF/A, OCR, XFA, Word…) remain names where appropriate.
# Plural rule: `plural_none` — every @plural row lists exactly one form.
# Context-sensitive wording and intentional unchanged strings are regression-tested in i18n/mod.rs.
